text:
Jun (Design): quick follow-up on the Private/VPC setup wizard 	6 networking step. pushed a micro-iteration that focuses on copy clarity and keyboard/a11y flows. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd-setup.

Priya (Product): saw it. love the single 'Network readiness' card. one ask: make the failure CTA explicit (e.g., 'Fix firewall rules') and include an ETA per check (Expected: 2	64 minutes).

Omar (Eng-Platform): agree. agent should run preflight probes and show a persistent re-run button. checks to surface: outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443, DNS resolution, NTP sync, and optional KMS endpoint. show statuses inline.

Tess (SRE): add a small collapsible 'Corporate proxy' help panel with example env vars (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) and how to curl via proxy. logs must be redacted and safe.

Jun (Design): proposed failure banner copy: "Network validation failed 	6 outbound access to api.redwood.ai:443 blocked. Click 'How to fix' for step-by-step guidance." shorter banner: "Network validation failed 	6 action required." Thoughts?

Priya (Product): good. success copy: "Network validated 	6 ready for provisioning." More explicit.

Omar (Eng-Platform): UX nit: while checks run, show spinner + 'Validating network...' and disable Next. keep detailed logs in a collapsible panel (not modal). offer a 'Re-run checks' telemetry event: private.setup.preflight.rerun.

Tess (SRE): sample safe debug commands to show in UI:
```
# test TLS
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/healthcheck
# test DNS
getent hosts api.redwood.ai || nslookup api.redwood.ai
```
Redact any ARNs/account IDs in outputs. Require explicit confirmation checkbox to 'Skip automated provisioning' if user selects manual mode.

setup-bot: preflight queued: tls,dns,ntp,kms. report: https://internal.redwood/checks/1748800123

Jun (Design): accessibility checklist: ensure checkbox groups use role="group" and aria-describedby; focus moves to first failing control after validation; failure banners meet contrast ratios; keyboard focus styles on re-run button. i'll update the frames and post when in staging. react with :eyes: to get a ping.

Priya (Product): :eyes: ping me when it's live in staging.

Omar (Eng-Platform): +1 include manual-skip telemetry: private.setup.manual.skip.

Tess (SRE): i'll draft a short appendix with sample iptables and firewall rules for the docs.

Jun (Design): thanks all 	6 closing the loop.
